title: Soulclaimer (勾魂) - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Soulclaimer (勾魂) in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Soulclaimer (勾魂) phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Soulclaimer (勾魂) is an optional encounter in Pangzhen, found at Dockside Warehouse, down and right. Beating it yields Parting Hooks.

sections.title: Where to Find the Soulclaimer (勾魂)
sections.content:
Location: Dockside Warehouse, down and right.

Appears in: Pangzhen.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is optional, which is why it can be left until the Sha-Chi pool and the Phantom Edge roster are deeper.

sections.title: How to Beat the Soulclaimer (勾魂)
sections.content:
What works

  • Break his guard to earn the Parting Hooks; the Dockside Warehouse route is easy to miss.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 31 of 60 in the progression order, in Pangzhen. Before it: Flame, the Lion Dance Grandmaster (舞狮尊主 烈焰). After it: Zhu Yuan. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
